angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 59,273,640 km at 3073.50 pc = 0.26 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, CP Cep: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 3073.5 +/- 120.1 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 3073.5 +/- 120.1 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.2534 +/- 0.0204 mas (same row, RUWE 1.01), 12.4 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 85.2 +/- 3.5 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, CP Cep: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 85.2 +/- 3.5 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 59,273,640 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4875 +/- 177 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 55, Name='CP Cep', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4875 +/- 177 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 55, Name='CP Cep', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 4875 +/- 177 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 0.3 from 2024A&A...690A.246T, the median of its 2 spectra; the 5 published values span log g 0.29 to 1.3, across which the limb law changes by at most 1.7% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A%26A...690A.246T)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
